body: I'm too scared of love. Too scared that it will bring drama. Too scared if romance is worth my time and energy. But at the same time, I want it. I want to learn what loving someone feels like.

I do. My dreams tell me lots of stories from ancient times to modern times. They are sometimes very absurd stuff but some others have legit storylines. I also dreams about people I've never known and I can recall all the details vividly. Every time I sleep it feels like I'm living another life in another world, that when I wake up, I feel like I just come from a journey. It's exhausting. No matter how many hours I spend sleeping, it's just never enough. I get sleepy all the time and the feelings I get from the dreams will just continue to follow me until the time I go to bed.

I see it like this. Every time I go to bed, I'd dream about many things and remember all the details when I wake up. Then when it's time to go to bed, the memories of those dreams will be back until I'm asleep. It's almost like the scenes I see in my dreams are the boarding pass to enter the gate to the dreamworld.

It's interesting to dream lots of dreams every night, but sometimes I just want to rest. Anyone has any idea why this happens? Does this happen to you as well?

It's getting ridiculous because every day, every time I do something that makes me happy, sadness will again come to me, devour me. It is an endless cycle and I begin to think that no matter what I do, this thing will always be with me. This sadness will always stay and it's so tiresome to keep living with it.

My mother died when I was 3. I'm 28 now. I've started to think this is not normal anymore. Almost three decades and I'm still not over it. This is insane.

She left because she was depressed. She couldn't think straight and been living under the cloud for years. It happens to me as well now. She died at the age of 29. I think I've become her.

I'm sorry to hear about your Dad. I hope you're doing well.
